\subsection{External Robustness Set}
\label{sec:robustness}
TrashNet photos share a white posterboard background, so the held-out test split cannot show
how the models behave on ordinary photos. We therefore collected an external set of everyday
waste photos on tables, floors, cloth and grass, under daylight, indoor and dim lighting, with
several phones. The set is audited for duplicates (including against TrashNet) and location
metadata, and is scored exactly once with the three models frozen in \texttt{protocol.json};
nothing is tuned on it. Results are pending and will be reported here.
